programme.title: 开心超人小剧场之趣味小课堂
好劇連場: 星落凝成糖
programme.desc: 由陳星旭和李蘭迪主演該劇根據作家一度君華的同名小説改編，講述人族皇室中一對性格迥異的雙生姐妹，因一場烏龍導致錯嫁姻緣，不僅鬧出笑話無數，更牽扯出兩段浪漫唯美之戀的古裝神話愛情故事人族皇后離奇生下了一正一邪雙生姐妹，姐姐青葵溫婉善良，受人族敬仰，被神族冊為天妃；妹妹夜曇李蘭迪飾則聰慧狡黠，受盡欺凌，因此被許給魔界做魔妃，神魔兩界迎親時，雙生姐妹花轎意外錯換，夜曇與神君玄商陳星旭飾成為歡喜冤家，而青葵入魔成為了三殿下嘲風爭儲的棋子，四界得知雙生姐妹身份關乎四界存亡後，想要殺掉雙生姐妹

programme.title: 天天成長記 第一至四季
趣談唐詩
programme.desc: 俗語說：熟讀唐詩三百首，不會吟時也會偷 無論是求學時期，或者在日常生活裡，我們都會接觸到唐詩有見及此，本台製作了一個名為趣談唐詩的節目，以有趣和深入淺出的手法，結合現代人的生活趣聞，帶大家去瞭解每一首唐詩背後的歷史淵源和故事

西拉沐淪
programme.desc: 西拉沐淪河發源於內蒙古高原的渾善達克沙地腹地，在赤峰境內奔流407千米後，匯入西遼河，最終注入渤海，是中國北方重要的河流之一西拉沐淪河流域作為內蒙古東部重要的水源涵養地，維持著周邊草原沙地濕地的生態平衡同時，流域內棲息著多種候鳥（如丹頂鶴白枕鶴）魚類（如瓦氏雅羅魚）及珍稀植物，是東亞澳大利西亞候鳥遷徙通道的重要組成部分，蜿蜒流淌的高原長河，孕育著豐富的野生動物種群和多樣的植被類型，使西拉沐淪河流域成為了中國北方的生物基因庫由中央廣播電視總台推出的西拉沐淪是中國首部北疆河流生態科學紀錄片全片共 4集，每集25分鐘深入內蒙古高原渾善達克沙地腹地，透過地質動物植物與環境依存關係，全方位展現西拉沐淪河流域（赤峰一帶）的壯麗自然景觀與豐富物種本節目由ampampampampamplt赤峰市融媒體中心ampampampampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.desc: 梅艷芳梁家輝吳家麗赤井英明主演故事講述1935年，梁森梁家輝飾告別心傷愛人梅伊梅艷芳飾，來到大後方參加地下黨，梅伊則按照吳先生曾江飾的安排成為夜總會歌女6年後，世界局勢隨太平洋戰爭爆發而動蕩不安梁森和革命黨員重返上海公共租界，當晚便目睹五個日本和尚慘遭殺害的景象，而幕後指使的竟是日本人白川國村隼飾梁尾隨至夜總會襲殺白川，但自身也多處負傷養傷之際，梁森重遇愛人梅伊，舊情不斷難以割捨同時白川之死亦激化租界內矛盾，76局特務頭子鐵澤民徐少強飾決定對地下黨進行無情清洗梅伊發現懷孕但梁森不知去向，無奈下嫁於日官野口，並隨他返回日本抗戰結束後，梁森欲到日本尋找梅伊

programme.desc: 어린이의 발달 단계에 맞춰 창의력을 키울 수 있는 프로그램

programme.title: 최고다! 호기심 딱지
programme.desc: 어린이의 발달 단계에 맞춰 창의력을 키울 수 있는 프로그램

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 왔다! 내 손주
programme.desc: 해외에 거주하고 있어 자주 보지 못하는 손자, 손녀들과 할머니, 할아버지가 만나 보내는 며칠의 시간. 뭉클한 감동이 깃든 만남부터 그들에게 주어진 짧은 기간 일어나는 일들 속에 따듯한 가족애를 담아내는 프로그램

programme.title: 아파트
programme.desc: 아파트 속 숨겨진 돈을 접수하기 위해 입대의회장 선거에 출마한 오아시스파 전직 보스 박해강이 주민들과 함께 비리를 타파해 가는 이야기

programme.title: 냉장고를 부탁해 since 2014
programme.desc: 최고의 셰프들이 스타들의 냉장고 속 재료를 활용해 요리 대결을 펼치는 요리 토크쇼

programme.title: 궁금한 이야기 Y
programme.desc: 실제로 일어난 사건 중 시청자들이 가장 궁금한 화제와 인물을 추적하여 궁금한 이야기의 왜WHY를 보여주는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: 생방송 투데이
programme.desc: 뉴스에서 트렌드, 이벤트, 여가 생활정보에 이르기까지 시청자들이 궁금해 하는 모든 것을 알차고 재미있고 정확하게 전달하는 종합 정보 와이드 프로그램

programme.title: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기
programme.desc: 눈길을 사로잡는 그 날, 그 사건으로부터 한 사람의 소시민으로서 내가 느낀 바를, 온전히 나의 시점에서 주관적으로 전달한다. 너 에게 꼭 들려주고 싶어! 친구, 배우자, 동료... 세 명의 이야기꾼이 스스로 공부하며 느낀 바를 각자의 이야기 친구가장 가까운 지인에게, 가장 일상적인 공간에서 1:1 로 전달한다.

programme.title: 누가 누가 잘하나
programme.desc: 어린이, 학생 및 일반인들의 동요 경연 프로그램.

programme.title: 2TV 생생정보
programme.desc: 대한민국 방방곡곡의 유익한 정보와 따뜻한 이야기를 생생하게 전달한다.

programme.title: 신상출시 편스토랑
programme.desc: 미식가 스타들이 혼자만 먹기에는 아까운 필살의 메뉴를 공개, 이 중 승리한 메뉴가 방송 다음 날 전국 편의점에 출시되는 신개념 신상 메뉴 서바이벌

programme.title: KBS 뉴스 5
programme.desc: 당일 발생한 국내외 주요뉴스를 종합 편성해 신속 보도.

programme.title: 동물의 왕국
programme.desc: BBC, 내셔널지오그래픽, NHK, 유럽의 최고 다큐제작사 등 세계 일류의 다큐멘터리 전문 제작사들이 제작한 고급 다큐멘터리들을 엄선하고, 우리말로 더빙하여 정확한 해설로 일반 시청자들에게 소개하여 생태계 이해를 돕는 국내 유일의 동물 전문 다큐멘터리이다.

programme.title: 6시 내고향
programme.desc: 고향을 떠난 도시인들의 각박한 삶에 위안을 주는 동시에 자기 고향에 대한 자긍심을 갖게 하고 다양한 문화를 접할 수 있다. 더불어 살아가는 공동체적 삶의 중요성을 일깨워주고 영농,유통정보 등의 제공으로 농어가 소득증대에 도움을 주고자 노력하고 있는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: 한국인의 밥상
programme.desc: 매일 우리는 밥상을 마주한다. 우리의 밥상 속 이야기를 통해 한국인들의 다양한 음식 문화를 보여주고, 식품과 식재료에 대한 영양학적 고찰을 통하여 올바른 정보를 제공하는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: KBS 뉴스 9
programme.desc: 당일발생 사안을 시청자들에게 신속히 전달하고 관련 현안을 종합 정리해 분석보도.

programme.title: 생방송 연금복권 720
programme.desc: 새로운 형식의 신개념 연금복권 추첨 방송

programme.title: 실화탐사대
programme.desc: 동시대를 사는 사람들의 나도 겪을 수 있었던 극적인 실화를 찾아 깊이 있는 취재와 영화적인 스토리텔링을 통해 느낌을 전달하는 프로그램

programme.title: 구해줘! 홈즈
programme.desc: 의뢰인이 원하는 집을 찾기 위해 스타들이 발품을 파는 리얼 발품 중개 배틀 프로그램

programme.title: 탐정들의 영업비밀 스페셜
programme.desc: 홈스, 코난처럼 대한민국에도 탐정이 있다? 집계된 탐정 수만 약 2만 명! 베일에 싸여있던 탐정들의 영업비밀 공개

programme.title: 건강히어로
programme.desc: 수많은 건강정보 속, 정확한 근거를 바탕으로 진실을 가려내는 프로그램

programme.title: 특종세상
programme.desc: 세상곳곳의 놀라운 이야기, 소문 속의 진실, 휴먼 스토리 등 살아 숨쉬는 특종 현장을 보여준다.

programme.title: 판도라
programme.desc: 어떠한 상황 속에서도 포기하지 않고 앞으로 나아갈 수 있도록 인간에게 남겨진 유일한 힘은 희망일 것이다. 정계 원로와 각 분야의 정치 고수들이 한 데 모여 한국 정치의 민낯을 해부하고 정치판의 숨겨진 비밀, 판도라의 상자를 연다! 그리하여 우리는 상자 안에 남겨진 새로운 희망을 이야기 하는 토론 쇼.

programme.title: 알콩달콩
programme.desc: 누구나 공감 할 수 있고 누구나 겪을 수 있는 일상 속 생활정보 이야기

programme.title: 유 퀴즈 온 더 블럭
programme.desc: You Quiz On The Block. Step by step 보통날을 살아가는 당신 앞에 나타난 유재석x조세호. 두 사람이 건넨 한마디. quotYou Quiz...?quot 평범한 사람들의 인생 무대인 길거리를 세트로 빌리고 세상 누구에게나 공평한 태양을 조명 삼아 여러분을 주인공으로 모시는 유쾌한 서프라이즈!

programme.title: M COUNTDOWN
programme.desc: 전 세계가 함께하는 World No.1 K-POP Chart Show 가요 트렌드를 이끄는 대한민국 대표 가수들을 만날 수 있는 K-POP Chart Show 엠카운트다운! Mnet USA와 Mnet Japan, Channel M을 통해 전세계 13개국에 방송되며 세계 어디서나 Mwave를 통해 시청할 수 있습니다. K-POP을 이끌어 나가는 대표 가수를 만나 볼 수 있는 것은 물론! 빠르게 변화하는 K-POP시장에 등장한 새로운 아티스트도 엠카운트다운을 통해 만나 볼 수 있습니다.

programme.title: 벌거벗은 세계사

programme.title: 반지의 제왕:반지 원정대
programme.desc: 절대반지를 둘러싼 우정과 모험. 1954년 첫 출간 이후 전세계에서 10억명 이상이 읽었다는 존 로널드 톨킨의 소설 lt반지의 제왕gt을 각색한 영화로, 아이들뿐만 아니라 성인들에게도 많은 사랑을 받은 대표적인 판타지 영화이다.

programme.title: 반지의 제왕:두 개의 탑
programme.desc: 전세계적으로 큰 화제를 모은 반지 원정대 두 번째 이야기. 뿔뿔이 흩어진 반지원정대의 험난한 모험과 중간계 전쟁의 암울한 서막. 판타지 소설의 고전이라 불리는 J.R.R.톨킨의 소설을 원작으로 하는 반지의 제왕 - 두 개의 탑은 절대 반지를 둘러싼 험난한 모험을 다룬 lt반지의 제왕gt 시리즈 그 두 번째 영화로, 전세계적으로 큰 인기를 얻으며 2003년 아카데미 특수효과상과 음향효과상을 수상한 작품이다.

男朋友
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 浪漫速成鄭敬淏 愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人復仇心的驅使下，他成為Gold Partners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 浪漫速成鄭敬淏 愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人復仇心的驅使下，他成為Gold Partners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘

programme.title: 男朋友完
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 週末同床

programme.title: 斬霸王

programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD世熙就讀高中的時候，爸爸最信任的左右手成俊在背後設計陷害，導致公司破產，爸爸也因此自殺身亡，並遺留下大筆債務年紀尚輕的世熙根本還不起這筆高利貸，成俊便順勢以此為藉口，佔有了世熙青春的肉體

programme.title: 金瓶雙艷
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD西門慶是個性虐待狂，雖已有一妻三妾，仍到處獵豔看上武大郎的妻子潘金蓮後，西門慶在貪財的王婆的說明下設計令潘金蓮上鉤，後三人又合議出毒計殺死了武大郎被西門慶納為妾後，為保地位，潘金蓮開始不斷配合西門慶嘗試種種變態性行為遇上友人花子虛之妻李瓶兒後，西門慶色心再起，終用卑劣手段將李瓶兒和花子虛的錢財一石二鳥弄到了手多出強勁敵手李瓶兒後，不甘就此失勢的潘金蓮為奪西門慶更多歡心與她展開明爭暗鬥

programme.title: 擋不住的瘋情
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD電腦公司經理孫志輝過著雙重人格的乖僻生活白日裡在公司勤勞做事，對女人與金錢嗤之以鼻；夜晚卻末尾百般設法接近自己的夢中情人 電視臺當紅掌管人黃潔怡孫志輝不只搬到黃所住公寓的對面用望遠鏡監視其的一舉一動，更用錄影機跟蹤拍攝，並用鐵棒經驗了所有對黃潔怡無禮或是希圖接近她的男人一次偶然的時機，孫志輝對於黃潔怡和她的有錢男友查理的恩愛妒火中燒，查理在黃潔怡身邊的頻頻出現讓孫志輝再也無法忍受，於是在二人訂婚的假面舞會上，孫志輝終於末尾採取舉動

programme.title: 關不住的誘惑
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD祥敏有個自閉症的兒子，為了送他參加特殊營隊，她孤身一人來到芬蘭奇弘是名建築師，外派到芬蘭，女兒飽受憂鬱症所苦，正在接受治療，妻子的精神也不穩定某天，兩人剛好因為孩子參加同一個營隊從起初的一片沉默，漸漸感到莫名地放鬆，甚至開始敞開心房突然來襲的暴風雪，將兩人困在湖畔小屋中，竟一時意亂情迷，不可自拔隔天，兩人道別後各自回歸原本的平靜生活某日，兩人在首爾再度巧遇，本該留在心中的那段異國情緣，再度席捲而來，開始動搖他們各自平淡無奇的已婚生活

programme.title: 春宮影院
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD一位遇到困境的年輕導演，他製作了許多不受人看的電影然而這次他的新作品有機會讓他大受歡迎，但黑手黨的阻礙，是否能讓他實現自己的夢想？

programme.title: 哭泣的嬸嬸
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD朋友的嬸嬸是年輕又性感的保險女王～為了嘗到她的肉體而投保了！身為好友的龍日和珍基，珍基勸龍日與賣保險的嬸嬸見一面，龍日見到年輕又充滿肉慾的嬸嬸，身體發燙無法降溫，龍日無法抗拒嫂嫂的肉體攻勢，答應投保，並等待著簽約日來臨，買入保險並得到贈禮後，龍日無法忘懷嫂嫂火熱的身體，以再做愛一次為條件，答應嫂嫂拉人加入投保另一方面，為了謝謝姪子珍基幫自己介紹客人，嬸嬸向珍基介紹了懂定存的後輩，珍基買入了定存，也收到了做愛的贈禮，龍日與珍基為了做愛，買入了無數個保險跟定存

programme.title: 禁慾俘虜
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD由美與丈夫宏太來到第一次約會的酒吧時，遇上著名攝影師Kenny Kenny不但拍攝了由美的引人身段，更獲得了她的身體 雖然對Kenny來說,由美只不過是他在無數一夜情經驗的其中一人， 但由美的想法卻是除了丈夫以外， Kenny便是她唯一的男人！為得到Kenny，由美引誘Kenny到別墅中及將他禁錮，並在Kenny打算逃走時剪去他的腳趾以示懲戒！承受著身心的威脅，卻漸對由美產生同情此間Kenny開始享受由美的特別性侍候，亦甚至忘記自己是個被禁錮的人...

programme.title: 風流女人2
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD小娟跟俊碩去旅行的時候，東旭跟敏書說差不多該回自己的家了敏書正下定決心要回家時，去旅行的小娟因為看到俊碩和其他女人通話，生氣的先回家了那天晚上，敏書的老公尚宇來接敏書，俊碩也向小娟下跪求饒敏書回家後，只留下小娟與俊碩的家變得空蕩蕩的俊碩去給敏書送的內衣包時，與敏書發生了性關係；而尚宇到小娟家找敏書的內衣包時，也同樣的發生了性關係

programme.title: 十日談
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD取材於喬萬尼薄伽丘小說十日談包括七個故事：一個年輕人兩次被騙，但最終發了財；一個年輕人冒充聾啞人混進修道院，亂了修女們的芳心；一名家庭主婦巧妙對付打斷她偷情的丈夫；一個惡棍欺騙臨終的教士；三兄弟謀殺妹妹的男友；一對青年男女屋頂偷情，被女方父母發現；一個教士出一惡招，能讓他當著人家丈夫的面姦汙對方妻子

programme.title: 少婦的誘惑

programme.desc: 端兒看到眾籌平台出事的新聞後，答應澤雨合作發展烹飪平台程凱發現被定垚耍了，大興問罪，卻突然對她有了異樣感覺力晨混入季生集團調查，高哲叮囑他小心高哲意外收到思妤來電，思妤工作的環保公司面臨倒閉，請求高哲施援手啟堂將智能家居引入傲堂旗下樓盤，取得巨大成功，定垚暗覺不安其後啟堂欲收購程凱的超級電池發展電動車，程凱因決定追求定垚而有保留澤雨首次在內地過生日，端兒炮製港式小吃慶祝，澤雨感動落淚

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 東張西望星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮今日突發環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 流行都市為觀眾介紹時令產品健康養生健體運動護膚化妝時尚服飾嬰幼兒護理育兒知識城中美食飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 珠海某大學區隱藏滋味手工菜，筲箕海鮮配陳村粉苦瓜撈起別具特色，江南百花雞更是經典名菜凱晴慧儀及後體驗騎馬樂，除了學騎術，不少得餵飼馬匹培養感情深圳的大學區也有美食，吃過爆膏大頭蝦鮮甜生蠔等火鍋料，再歎粥底精華超市海鮮拼盤六十元人仔有找，還要無伏？香港都有性價比高的日式廚師發辦，十八道菜食材皆來自日本，人均僅約四百元！接着味遊泰國，品嚐由摘星名廚秘製食譜的招牌魷魚船麵火鍋

programme.title: 東坡家事29粵
programme.desc: 季常和大妹請月娥回家，月娥拒絕說書人將東坡詞構成東坡和琴操故事，皇上聽後懷恨，拒絕東坡請辭東坡和少游洪四到酒館飲酒解愁，東坡詩興大發，在酒桌寫上四句詩東坡被捕下獄，皇上唸出東坡詩，罵他叛逆

programme.title: 高朋滿座167粵
programme.desc: 根發起男士暢飲聚會，但他發現人數愈來愈少麗在代替喜分發花紅，但根卻發現自己的那份被麗以各種理由扣去，根怒極欲報仇，卻被亨發現當晚，眾人更迫根負起責任，要他交伙食費及家用，根為此離家出走

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心12粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康和穆念慈為了賺取回家盤纏，在街頭賣藝，官差故意為難，楊康氣怒之下打傷他們；郭靖到桃花島找黃蓉時遇上周伯通，周伯通想讓郭靖陪他拆招解悶；眼見郭靖執意尋找黃蓉，周伯通建議郭靖找師父洪七公來給自己撐腰

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今集邀得梁漢文方力申兩位帥哥，Do姐顯得心花怒放，並大談歐美日乘計程車的畀貼士文化台灣問題專員走進樓上舖，享受電鑽男既刺激又舒暢的服務，到底搞邊科？緊接試食題，名廚即場以小牛的某部位烹調美食，梁漢文瞓身使用雙重錦囊，看來對答中食材胸有成竹！K小姐介紹韓國百貨店中一件男女老幼皆適用的產品，是甚麼東西？踏入積分兌換貨幣環節，有嘉賓不聽隊友意見，結果看着對手執到寶！

programme.title: The Getting Ready Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitchs campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Cucumber
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its Cucumber performing Cool Under Pressure while trying to not let any obstacle ruin her calm routine.

programme.title: Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertatos brand new Tato Car but doesnt realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they dont realise she intends on plundering Evil Peas freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Where? There!
programme.desc: LaaLaa and Po play a game of hide and seek. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and LaaLaa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Book
programme.desc: In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say book and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different books and explore how they look and feel. We see a flip book, a flap book and Dee helps make a scrapbook. We see a gold book, a fluffy book and even meet a child dressed as a book! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Snowflakes
programme.desc: Its summer in OKIDO, but Messy wants to chill out in the snow, so hes lucky when the snowflakes come out to play!

programme.title: Ready Sheddy Go
programme.desc: Nori and Dot are stuck in a treehouse without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, thats how!

programme.title: Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Blueys new employee in the middle of Dads backyard workout.

programme.title: Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggees infectious laughter, once everyone starts, its so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Eugenes Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: Glitch tries to teach the Grimbots by drawing on a chalkboard. Before he can finish, his last piece of chalk snaps and the grumpy Grandmaster demands the Grimbots find a fresh supply. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the White Cliffs of Dover in England, to cheer Kyan as he finishes a cross-channel swim, but a large cloud of dust blocks his way to the shore. On the beach, Lars and Foz find the Grimbots mining the cliffs with a big drill, causing a big crack to spread across the rock face. Can

programme.title: The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Blueys eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Luckys Dads pie.

programme.title: Andy and the Hungry Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Andy and Jen are throwing themselves a party to celebrate an epic year on Dino Island but discover that their prehistoric pals have been helping themselves to all the party food.

programme.title: Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. Its time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Happys First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his sons arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Its an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wifes rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. Its one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and Chinas top sports leagues. We examine the changes and growth in Chinas domestic leagues, as the country undergoes an incredible economic transformation. Our exclusive features, Tackling China, CBA Stories, and Beyond the Baseline, take you behind the scenes and closer to the top athletes in China, by providing a unique perspective on the top sports stories

programme.desc: A team of U.S. NCIS agents and the Australian Federal Police come together to keep naval crimes in check in the Indo-Pacific.

programme.desc: Venesh unpacks feelings of shame and guilt after a heavy counselling session with Dr Shamala following an incident in the kitchen. After a tense commotion in the dayroom, Sani reaches out to Muthu for advice. Charlize makes futile attempts to convince DSP Lee to allow Abu to join the Fathers day event.

programme.title: FBI: International S3
programme.desc: The FBIs International Fly Team tracks and neutralizes threats against American citizens.

programme.title: Wheel Of Fortune S42
programme.desc: Ryan Seacrest takes over as the new host for the well-loved gameshow.

programme.title: Beat Shazam USA S7
programme.desc: Jamie Foxx presents three teams with the challenge of recognising some hit songs by famous artists from around the world.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Some answers are good, but only one is UNBEATABLE in this knock-out quiz tournament where contestants could win up to 10,000.

programme.title: Weather Gone Viral S8
programme.desc: From whirling tornadoes to torrential rains, to harrowing hurricanes, Weather Gone Viral gives viewers unprecedented access to some of the most insane meteorological moments from around the world. Featuring videos of the most extreme and destructive weather conditions, firsthand accounts, and professional meteorologists sharing tales from the front lines, viewers get to experience the fury of Mother Nature.

programme.title: The Chefs Line - Series 1
programme.desc: Every top restaurant has a line of chefs leading to the top, from the Commis chef to the Head chef. This celebratory cooking competition pitches at-home cooking enthusiasts against professionals, starting at the bottom and working their way up. Can they beat their way to the top of The Chefs Line?

programme.title: Cooking Up A Fortune
programme.desc: Brand new series where the UKs most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europes busiest food markets.

programme.title: A Taste of Australia in Vietnam
programme.desc: Host Luke Nguyen travels through Vietnam meeting with inspiring Australians who represent the spirit of the Australia-Vietnam relationship while cooking with Australian produce and enjoying Vietnamese regional dishes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters
programme.desc: Yu-Gi-Oh! follows the adventures of high school student Yugi, who has a magical secret that comes to life when he plays his favorite card game.

programme.title: Zoom The White Dolphin S2
programme.desc: Yann, an intrepid 15-year-old and his 7-year-old sister, Marina, live with their Uncle Patrick on the paradise island of Maotou. With Zoom, a white dolphin of exceptional intelligence and other friends from the island, they go on amazing adventures.

programme.title: Sam Julia S1
programme.desc: Coming from a distant island, Julia, a cute and energetic little mouse, has moved into The Mouse Mansion where she feels a bit like a stranger. There she meets Sam, a welcoming and crafty little mouse. Julias only family is her mom. Sam on the contrary has a large family with a mom, dad and six siblings. programme.title: 他从火光中走来Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 卧底娇娃Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛

programme.title: 太平年Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷钱弘俶赵匡胤郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱秩序崩溃生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，纳土归宋，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 天知道Fates Secret
programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人感化世间暴戾的感人故事剧情强调善的力量与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人充满信念的作品Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. However, her father is nowhere to be found, and the house has been left vacant for a long time, rumoured to have vagrants dying inside. Just then, Angel is tasked to sell her companys haunted houses. As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her fathers whereabouts

programme.desc: Danial datang ke kampung dan memujuk Adlina agar kembali semula ke universiti. Di kampung Adlina mula merasakan bapa dan abang-abangnya mengambil berat terhadapnya. programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cowo
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dari sudut pandang Kelvin, seorang lelaki yang cuba memahami pasangannya, Mila, menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka. Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Cikgu Lutfi yang baru ditukarkan ke sekolah berusaha membantu Hadi dan adiknya yang kematian ibu, tetapi konflik timbul apabila ibu saudara mereka kembali dan menimbulkan masalah keluarga

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih 2
programme.desc: Lanjutan dari Ketika Cinta Bertasbih yang mengisahkan Azzam kembali ke Indonesia selepas 9 tahun belajar di Kairo. Walaupun sudah bergelar sarjana, dia sukar cari kerja dan dipengaruhi tekanan masyarakat. Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: Rahasia Tersembunyi Di Balik Suara Rintihan
programme.desc: Baskara menyimpan trauma sejak kecil yang menjadikannya seorang yang pendiam dan penuh misteri. Malah, isterinya, Hana, tidak mengetahui rahsia yang selama ini disembunyikannya. Kemunculan suara rintihan seorang wanita di rumah mereka mula menimbulkan tanda tanya dan membongkar rahsia yang selama ini terpendam.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Di Antara Dua Cinta
programme.desc: Pada hari ulang tahun perkahwinan Shafira dan Rafael yang ke-2, Shafira dikejutkan dengan berita bahawa Rafael telah terlibat dalam satu kemalangan, dan jasadnya tidak ditemui. Beberapa tahun berlalu, Rafael akhirnya disahkan meninggal dunia. Shafira kemudian membuat keputusan untuk berkahwin semula dengan Julian. Namun, di puncak kebahagiaan perkahwinan mereka, Rafael tiba-tiba muncul kembali.

programme.title: Shock Mystery Sr.2
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: The Tang Mist
programme.desc: Set during the Chuigong era of the Wu ZhouTang Dynasty, the story follows Di Renjie as he grows disillusioned with the political intrigues of Empress Wu Zetians imperial court. Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

Through real stories, lighthearted conversations, and practical tips on relationships, parenting, and home life, the program highlights touching and humorous moments that help viewers navigate family harmony with ease.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his sons arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her fathers name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

programme.title: Nagesh Thiraiarangam
programme.desc: The story revolves around Nagesh, who decides to sell his fathers old theatre to arrange money for his sisters marriage. What happens when Nagesh realises that the theatre is haunted?

programme.title: Mirugaa
programme.desc: Forest officials in Kotagiri hunt a man-eating tiger that is attacking innocent people. At the same time, a serial killer is on the prowl for wealthy single women.

programme.title: Enna Solla Pogiraai
programme.desc: Vikram, a young man, plans to make his fiancee fall in love with him. However, when his plan backfires, he finds himself embroiled in a love triangle.

programme.title: Guna 369
programme.desc: The life of Guna, a happy-go-lucky man, turns upside down when he is falsely framed for a murder and imprisoned. After his release, he sets off to hunt the real culprits and expose their crimes.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

生活快易通第164集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的萬人美老師－郭昱晴擔任主持人以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 生活智多星第1815集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 青春進化論第94集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓勵創新創業的風潮下，台灣未來的發展要有競爭力，即需要不斷的創新，讓年輕人有更多機會實現想法及創意，不僅是在協助青年圓夢，更是在打造國家的未來節目中創業者分享創業甘苦談，創業時面臨的心理掙扎，以及如何克服困難，堅持理想，繼續走下去青年創ya家主持人曾寶儀打破傳統一問一答的制式訪問，以如同家人朋友間的聊天談心，讓各種你想得到的想不到的青年創ya家，拋開緊張與包袱，輕鬆自在地分享自己的青春進化論

programme.title: 手術直播間第11集
programme.desc: 講述天才醫生鄭仁為查多年前的冤案來到海城醫院，與急診科主任蘇雲組成搭檔在一次次搶救生死的過程中，他們不僅面對醫學挑戰，也揭開醫院內部隱藏的黑暗秘密，逐步逼近當年的真相鄭仁用專業治癒病患，蘇雲則以溫暖守護患者與團隊，兩人共同成長彼此信任，實現醫者初心，也在人性與職業的考驗中，找到生命的意義與愛的力量

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第224集
programme.desc: 公視早安新聞（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報後半小時為以英語播報的Good Morning Taiwan, PTS2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的公視英語新聞（PTS English News）

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第162集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原公視手語新聞改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目手語資訊站，用輕鬆方式看見生活新聞資訊另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元手語新聞通，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語

programme.title: senay345第2季:第147集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，族語童謠裡述說的是我們的根，全新型態的兒童少年節目senay345，將透過活潑創新的兒童音樂節目形式，提供不同族群孩童一個享受展演的舞台每一集會邀請二位孩童，在節目中演唱族語歌曲，聽著小朋友說著族語故事，透過童趣的自然對話與互動激發創作力和表達能力，一起感受到純粹快樂自然的沉浸在族語世界裡

programme.title: Talagay 我最強！第1季:第7集

programme.title: kakudan時光機第9季:第95集
programme.desc: Kakudan為台灣原住民排灣語，文化，慣習的意思，希望可以從台灣原住民族雋永的文化，找到實踐的道路台灣原住民族在這塊土地上已生活了八千年，祖先留下了珍貴的文化資產與族群智慧惟因過去的歷史面對不同時代的遷徙漢化與日治時期殖民政權的干擾，使得原住民傳統文化的存續面臨斷層與式微的挑戰然而處於文化逐漸式微的困境，又面對長者生命的迅速凋零，我們如何搶救文化？如何教育下一代有正確的文化知識與視野？如何把傳統說得更清楚？

programme.title: 大自然生趣第35集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.desc: 柔伊的小兒子查理離家讀大學，想請柔伊烤他最愛的巧克力豆餅乾寄過去柔伊去同是烘焙師的好朋友莎拉基弗家，觀摩學習莎拉在2019年風靡網路的摔烤盤獨門技巧，用在烤給查理的餅乾上，製造餅乾邊緣特別酥脆的口感查理的眾多室友得知柔伊要烤餅乾寄給查哩，各自提出想吃不同口味布朗尼的要求柔伊用一個烤盤烤出花生醬加餅乾榛果醬三種巧克力和原味等四種口味的布朗尼，滿足所有孩子的請求

programme.title: 湖濱淘寶翻修篇第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 強和安柏想在蓋斯頓湖上找一間房子，作為周末放鬆與親友共度美好時光的好去處

programme.title: 問題皮膚救星第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 艾瑪克雷松醫師是皮膚專科醫師，她希望幫助人們改善膚況，重建生活品質，重拾信心露易絲從小就有嚴重的濕疹，因為突然斷然停用，造成濕疹嚴重復發，在艾瑪的耐心溝通與治療下，露易絲的濕疹獲得大幅改善安德魯因為頭部長了蟹足腫而不敢與人交際，後來也因為艾瑪的幫助，重新走入人群史考特長年受背上的粉刺與膿皰所苦，也在艾瑪的治療下重拾信心，更聽從了醫生的建議開始戒菸與減重

programme.title: 動物園開飯第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集的動物園開飯介紹大猩猩熊貓長頸鹿與狐獴大貓熊最愛的食物熱量並不高，且需要耗時消化，因此牠們每天除了在吃，就是睡覺以避免體力流失長頸鹿雖然看似優雅，但必要時候也有攻擊性，牠們的主食是洋槐，不過也吃水果和葉菜類大猩猩其實有別於刻板印象，是溫和的草食動物，熱愛蔬菜的牠們每天也藥吃上極大量的食物維持體力狐獴雖小，卻不怕挑戰危險動物，牠們喜歡獵捕蠍子來吃，此外昆蟲和蔬果也在牠們的菜單上

programme.title: 家有惡犬第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 我們忍不住愛上牠們，面對這些四條腿的家人，這是無條件的愛人類最好的朋友惡行全都錄，宛如我們最可怕的敵人我們走遍全世界，尋找最壞的狗狗，所以請你坐好，我們即將倒數選出冠軍印第安納不喜歡鏡中小狗的模樣，因此菲利浦貝勒蕭的愛犬發動攻擊，但牠撞到鏡子之後的確出現嚴重的複視艾波與塔菲這兩隻喜樂蒂牧羊犬喜歡成為目光焦點，因此在羅賓斯家中做家事很快就演變成雙重麻煩有時候我們的寵物無法控制自己，牠們將家裡破壞殆盡找到最不尋常的地點，或是被最奇怪的東西吸引梗犬班尼有一個奇怪的習慣，班尼把水碗當成浴缸，但牠依舊從裡面喝水模仿貓派屈是狗狗來福的影子，當來福躲到沙發後面派屈也緊跟在後最後奪冠的是抵抗

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 介紹自然界最堅忍不拔的前20名動物，見識牠們如何善用攻守策略打擊對手抵禦敵人

programme.title: 家有惡犬第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 我們忍不住愛上牠們，面對這些四條腿的家人，這是無條件的愛人類最好的朋友惡行全都錄，宛如我們最可怕的敵人我們走遍全世界，尋找最壞的狗狗，所以請你坐好，我們即將倒數選出冠軍你聽過別打擾沉睡的狗這句話，你即將知道原因，因為我們找到一些有嚴重起床氣的寵物大丹狗芬恩體重超過150磅也睡得很沉，看著這個大女孩醒來氣勢相當驚人天底下沒有任何一隻貓比明克斯更肥，也沒有太多狗比明克斯更肥，他們擄獲我們的心，佔據地盤，並且用生命守護迪索這隻兩歲的吉娃娃從小就開始偷竊與囤積無論史考特怎麼做，鬆獅狗凱西迪總能想出辦法擊敗他，但牠能贏得惡犬之最嗎？本周獲得冠軍榮銜的是潘妮洛普，偷走高爾夫球的小偷，牠喜

programme.title: 動物園開飯第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集節目要看企鵝，北極熊，狐猴和犀牛的餐點和生活情況這次要介紹的企鵝住在麥哲倫海峽海岸，牠們適應了溫暖的氣候，所以住在動物園也住得很開心因為每一隻都是人工飼養，所以每一隻都很挑食，如果外觀不好看或是不對胃就不會吃下肚不過在野外可是抓到什麼就吃甚麼北極熊也同樣適應了溫暖的氣候，不過牠們很喜歡游泳，每次都在泳池很長一段時間雖然在野外需要吃大量脂肪禦寒但是在動物園卻不需要另外還有瀕危的狐猴和犀牛

programme.title: 生命不受限第1季:第2集

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹一些世界上最英勇的犬種，包括澳洲牧牛犬拉薩狗喀地干威爾斯柯基犬阿富汗獵犬乞沙比克灣獵犬拉布拉多獵犬聖伯納犬以及紐芬蘭犬從牠們被人類培育出來的目的，探索牠們與人類之間的關係與聯繫這些犬種不但具有英勇的性格，同時也膽識過人，清楚自己身負的任務，為了盡好自己的本分竭盡全力與此同時，牠們也與人類飼主產生了微妙的互動關係，雙方互相依存

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹了一些世界上最稀有的犬種，從為了驅趕羊群而培育的波利犬，以牽制眼鏡蛇為目的而培育的泰國背脊犬，有著敏銳嗅覺能找出松露所在的拉戈托羅馬閣挪露犬，在古印加帝國被當成熱水瓶撫慰疼痛的秘魯印加蘭花犬，會以單音嚎叫的新幾內亞唱犬，以及以獵熊聞名的卡累利亞熊犬透過這些稀有犬種與當今世界人類的互動，一窺少數犬種的特徵和個性

programme.title: 袋鼠海灘救援隊第25集

programme.title: 瑪莎與熊第46集
programme.desc: 瑪莎是個充滿朝氣活力四射的小女孩，住在離森林不遠的小木屋裡有天意外地闖進住在森林的熊熊家，開始了充滿歡笑與奇妙的生活從馬戲團退休的熊熊，在森林裡度過了安穩平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了瑪莎，為他的生活增添了許多樂趣，從一開始害怕瑪莎的調皮搗蛋，到逐漸他們成為了最棒的朋友在他們的生活裡充滿著瑪莎的好奇心與熊熊對瑪莎悉心的教導與照顧 瑪莎與熊來自於俄羅斯的3D動畫，故事內容源自於俄羅斯的童話，在俄羅斯受到了大朋友與小朋友的歡迎，故事搬到現代的大螢幕中，更增添了許多冒險故事動畫中所呈現的音樂與內容都有著濃濃的俄羅斯風情，並透過立體3D的呈現方式帶來了視覺與聽覺上的饗宴 瑪莎與熊以輕

programme.title: 寶貝星樂園第6季:第3集

programme.title: 紙箱做玩具第29集

programme.title: 瑪莎與熊第47集
programme.desc: 瑪莎是個充滿朝氣活力四射的小女孩，住在離森林不遠的小木屋裡有天意外地闖進住在森林的熊熊家，開始了充滿歡笑與奇妙的生活從馬戲團退休的熊熊，在森林裡度過了安穩平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了瑪莎，為他的生活增添了許多樂趣，從一開始害怕瑪莎的調皮搗蛋，到逐漸他們成為了最棒的朋友在他們的生活裡充滿著瑪莎的好奇心與熊熊對瑪莎悉心的教導與照顧 瑪莎與熊來自於俄羅斯的3D動畫，故事內容源自於俄羅斯的童話，在俄羅斯受到了大朋友與小朋友的歡迎，故事搬到現代的大螢幕中，更增添了許多冒險故事動畫中所呈現的音樂與內容都有著濃濃的俄羅斯風情，並透過立體3D的呈現方式帶來了視覺與聽覺上的饗宴 瑪莎與熊以輕

programme.title: 名偵探柯南 100萬美元的五稜星第1集

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第37集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星兔寶寶太菲鴨傻大鳥崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界

programme.title: 豆豆先生第429集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: SuperWings第34集
programme.desc: 講述了飛機機器人樂迪與一群稱為Super Wings的小伙伴環遊世界，為小朋友遞送包裹，並幫助他們解決困難的故事作品最大的特點是每一集發生的城市都不同，用精美的畫面展現了世界多元文化，例如名勝建築語言節日和美食等故事傳遞著善良勇敢歡樂和友愛，讓孩子在每一次新的神奇之旅中，可以開闊眼界並認識到多彩絢麗的地球家園

programme.title: POLI第38集
programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: 我的女兒孝心第53集
programme.desc: 將一生奉獻給家人的李孝心，本是田徑的明日之星，因代替拋家棄子的父親扛下養家重擔只好輟學孝心要照顧媽媽兩個哥哥和一個弟弟，她在江南的健身中心工作，每天一大早就開始為家人的生活奔走，不僅要做體力活，還得應付各種情緒，長期下來令她疲憊不堪這天，孝心決定自立門戶追求屬於自己的幸福生活，而家人們也該各自學習獨立了

programme.title: 桃花映江山第22集
programme.desc: 北苑公主姜桃花和世子長玦自二人母妃被郘后害死後，一直遭受郘后折磨，姜桃花帶著長玦伺機逃跑，卻被宮中侍衛抓獲郘后將年幼的長玦送去軍中，美名歷練，實則是想除去世子而又不擔罪名時值北苑與祈國連年征戰後，北苑決定向祈國和親乞和，姜桃花自請遠嫁祈國，以保全長玦性命姜桃花在和親途中熟讀祈國國情，祈國孟秦兩大世家分別支持世子與二王子，世子之爭暗流湧動，祈王為了制衡世家則扶植了心狠手辣的布衣宰相沈在野而姜桃花所要嫁的則是一向不受祈王所喜的四王子穆無瑕

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒第9集
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 極速引爆

programme.title: 鬼天廈
